predecessor_reference.note: the predecessor wave judged verdicts at Cell-Ontology level with its own four arms; this card re-reads the same quantities through the no-regression harness on the shipped default route, so the two are compared as directions, not as identical instruments

library_gains_note: every takeover is graded against the author's own label for the cluster, so a `truly_inconsistent` gain is a takeover on a cluster of another class, not a repair
harm_cells_note: cells whose grade moved DOWN (consistent -> anything lower, related -> lower, inconsistent -> mixed), cell-weighted, under the recorded declarations; reported whether or not a criterion trips, never omitted

acceptance.rule: PREREG section 4: GO requires (a) PASS on all three readings -- PASS_ATTRIBUTED is not sufficient for an activation, (b) the aggregate `inconsistent` share rising on no reading and on no dataset, (c) every moved cluster attributed with zero `unexpected` and the flipped default equal to the injection arm, (d) the kill switch restoring the pre-flip default byte-for-byte (judged by l3)

in_sample_disclosure: IN-SAMPLE READING: the library was selected on the same 28 public volumes it is measured on, so this is a coverage/harm reading, not a validation, not an independent test and not an accuracy claim. It is measured at Cell-Ontology level against the author's per-cluster majority label; two of the library's 17 entries (classical / non-classical monocyte) already fail their own pre-registered coverage bar and are carried as FAIL in the library's own record.
